SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments, p.prosecdef, p.provolatile, p.proconfig, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner_name, p.proacl, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS definition FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('claim_payment_rep_stamping','cancel_booking','guard_booking_cancellation_invoices','guard_invoice_booking_cancellation','guard_invoice_booking_link_cancellation') ORDER BY p.proname, identity_arguments;

SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname IN ('zz_guard_booking_cancellation_invoices','zz_guard_invoice_booking_cancellation','zz_guard_invoice_booking_link_cancellation','trg_organization_write_context') ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname;
